entries.title: When the Villain Changes Form
entries.fragment: After the villain changes form, all attachment cards, status cards, boost cards, damage, and other game elements associated with the villain remain as they are.

entries.title: When a Villain Stage is Defeated
entries.fragment: After a villain stage is defeated, the next stage of the villain deck enters play on the same side as the just defeated stage.

entries.title: When Norman Osborn Attacks
entries.fragment: Norman Osborn (I)’s ability reads “Forced Interrupt: When Norman Osborn would attack, place 1 infamy counter on Criminal Enterprise instead.” Since Norman Osborn’s “Forced Interrupt“ ability places a counter instead of attacking, cards that trigger when the villain attacks do not resolve because no attack activation was performed.

entries.title: When Green Goblin Schemes
entries.fragment: Green Goblin (I)’s ability reads “Forced Interrupt: When Green Goblin would scheme, remove 1 madness counter from State of Madness instead.” Since Green Goblin’s “Forced Interrupt“ ability removes a counter instead of scheming, cards that trigger when the villain schemes do not resolve because no scheme activation was performed.

entries.title: When Revealed (Green Goblin) / When Revealed (Norman Osborn)
entries.fragment: If an ability reads “When Revealed (Green Goblin)”, that ability triggers only if the Green Goblin side of the villain is in play.

entries.title: PLAYING A CARD
entries.fragment: To play a card from their hand, a player performs the following steps: Place the card they want to play on the table.

entries.title: ALLY LIMIT
entries.fragment: Each player may have up to three allies in play under their control at any given time.

entries.title: USING A BASIC POWER
entries.fragment: Basic powers can be found on the player’s identity card.

entries.title: RESOURCE COSTS
entries.fragment: Resource costs are paid by generating resources.

entries.title: DEALING DAMAGE
entries.fragment: Many card abilities and attacks deal damage.

entries.title: USING AN ALLY
entries.fragment: During their turn, a player may use any number of allies they control to attack an enemy or to thwart a scheme.

entries.title: ACTION ABILITY
entries.fragment: Action abilities are indicated by the word “Action” in bold.

entries.title: ENCOUNTER CARDS
entries.fragment: Some encounter cards have action abilities that players may use while the card is in play.

entries.title: ABILITIES
entries.fragment: In addition to action abilities, which a player can trigger during their turn (or by request during another player’s turn), there are a few other types of triggered abilities in the game: Interrupts, Responses, and Resource abilities.

entries.title: END OF A PLAYER’S TURN
entries.fragment: When a player has completed everything they can or wish to do on their turn, that player announces that their turn is complete.

entries.title: END OF PLAYER PHASE
entries.fragment: To end the player phase, perform the following steps: In player order, each player may discard any number of cards from their hand, and must discard down to their hand size (located at the bottom of their identity card) if they have more cards than their hand size.

entries.title: VILLAIN PHASE
entries.fragment: During the villain phase, the enemies strike back!

entries.title: MINION ACTIVATIONS
entries.fragment: The villain activates once against each player, in player order.

entries.title: SCHEME
entries.fragment: If the player is in alter-ego form, the villain (and each minion engaged with that player) schemes.

entries.title: HERO FORM: ENEMIES ATTACK
entries.fragment: If the player is in hero form, the villain (and each minion engaged with that player) attacks.

entries.title: DEAL ENCOUNTER CARDS
entries.fragment: Deal one card from the encounter deck facedown to each player in player order.

entries.title: REVEAL ENCOUNTER CARDS
entries.fragment: All of the encounter cards dealt in the previous step are revealed and resolved, one at a time, in player order.

entries.title: SIDE SCHEME ICONS
entries.fragment: If a side scheme has the crisis icon, it must be defeated before threat can be removed from the main scheme.

entries.title: WHEN REVEALED ABILITIES
entries.fragment: If a revealed encounter card has any “When Revealed” abilities, those abilities resolve immediately after the card enters play.

entries.title: WHEN DEFEATED ABILITIES
entries.fragment: Some minions and side schemes have “When Defeated” abilities.

entries.title: ALTER-EGO FORM AND HERO FORM
entries.fragment: Often, the way an encounter card resolves depends on whether the player revealing the card is in hero or alter- ego form.

entries.title: NEMESIS SIDE SCHEMES
entries.fragment: If a card instructs a player to put a nemesis side scheme into play, the nemesis side scheme associated with the player that drew the card is placed in the play area, and their nemesis minion is put into play engaged with that player.
